_note: Template only - the loader skips every file whose name starts with '_'. Save a copy as the character's name with the file-name punctuation stripped and lowercased: 'Hoshino.glb' -> hoshino.json, 'Hina (Dress).glb' -> hinadress.json. Loaded on first use, so you only need a file for a character you actually want to change.
_shape: reactions = event -> lines. states = <tag> -> lines (or <tag> -> {event: lines, '*': lines}). chat_topics = extra topics only this character starts. pair_lines = <other character> -> {greeting|work|...: [[line, tag], ...]}.
_events: 'idle' is standing around, 'poke' was clicked, 'petting' was patted. 'state_enter' fires once when the computer state starts (Sensei opened Blue Archive) and 'state_exit' when it stops - the natural place for a line about that specific game or site. Scope pools to an event so a poke is still a poke; a plain list answers EVERY event.
_placeholders: {name} and {me} are the speaker, {other} the listener, {pronoun} her pronoun. From the watcher: {app} 'Genshin Impact', {site} 'youtube', {battery} '42%', {time} '14:05', {focus_minutes}, {session_minutes}.

battery_low: Sensei, my... your battery. Charge it. Please.
late_night: It is the middle of the night. Why are you awake?

idle: Sensei, you are playing our game again.
state_enter: They made a game about us, Sensei. Is that strange?
What are we learning today, Sensei?

naps: Have you tried sleeping on a title bar, {other}?
